Lac La Biche, Alberta
Contains modified Copernicus Sentinel data 2025

Source & image record ↗ · Copernicus Sentinel data licence

Lakeland Métis Nation identifies the Lac La Biche region as the main setting of the Métis community it serves. This view shows the settlement and nearby shoreline. Sentinel-2 image cropped and resized for the Atlas.
